sayLines.line: 📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."
The village feels it — the bond dips, but holds. They endure together.
